relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Other studies have demonstrated that TRPV1 activation is a key upstream trigger of CGRP‐mediated gastroprotection.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Fifteen of these studies identified CGRP as an endogenous gastroprotective factor

key_findings: Scoping review of 30 studies: CGRP plays a context-dependent, stress- and nociception-related role in AUD, not a direct driver of drinking.
CGRP is gastroprotective against ethanol injury via TRPV1-dependent release; caution for anti-CGRP therapy in advanced liver disease.
